entities.summary: Maurizio Ferraris is an Italian continental philosopher and scholar, whose name is associated especially with the philosophical current named "new realism"—Ferraris wrote the Manifesto of New Realism in 2012, which was published in 2014)—which shares significant similarities with speculative realism and object oriented ontology.
